messages:
Elena (CEO): quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands sec/privacy segment. drop short clarifying q's. :wave:
Lina (Customer Success): a customer asked if we can share a SOC2 snapshot before the Type II is out?
Arman (CISO): yes — we'll publish a SOC2 readiness snapshot and control matrix next week. full Type II report will be available under NDA after audit closes (ETA early Q4).
Priya (Head of Product): will the controls block any hosted features?
Arman (CISO): minimal. only security-sensitive features will be gated until controls are validated. most launches continue as planned.
Jo (Eng Infra): VPC/private deploy status: late Q3 pilot for isolated control plane + separate audit logs, GA targeted Q4. pilot customers get export instructions.
Lina (Customer Success): retention question: can customers request longer than default retention?
Kofi (Legal): yes, long-term retention is an enterprise add-on; will require contractual addendum and DSR handling.
A user: BYOK for hosted — available now?
Jo (Eng Infra): BYOK available now for Dedicated/Private. hosted CMK/BYOK (wrapped keys) planned by EOY; HSM-backed option later.
Arman (CISO): note: BYOK affects backups and restores (envelope encryption). recovery needs key access unless escrow is agreed.
Priya (Head of Product): will there be a customer console for compliance artifacts?
Jo (Eng Infra): yes — a compliance tab with certs, audit export, and onboarding checklist. initial release planned Q4.
deploy-bot: Docs updated: security/readiness-summary https://internal.redwood/docs/sec-readiness
Elena (CEO): thanks. if you have enterprise customers needing early access to BYOK or extended retention, DM Arman + Kofi with the artifact list. closing thread in 24h.
